badge: FIRST ANANTARA IN THE U.S. · PRE-LAUNCH
description: Anantara Residences Miami marks the North American debut of Anantara Hotels & Resorts, the award-winning luxury hospitality brand of Minor Hotels. The 50-story landmark at 3601 Biscayne Boulevard sits where Edgewater, the Design District, Midtown, Wynwood, and Miami Beach converge. One Thousand Group developed the tower in partnership with Minor Hotels, with architecture by Kohn Pedersen Fox and interiors by Patricia Urquiola. The building delivers 200 total residences in two collections, plus 50 hotel suites owned and operated by Anantara for the life of the building.
editorialLine: Without end. Anantara arrives in America.

investmentThesis: North America's first Anantara-branded residences are owned and operated by Anantara for the life of the building, with Nam Jai Concierge services available at contract. Pricing starts at $1.6M for private one-bedrooms (913 to 1,053 SF) and $1.8M for furnished resort one-bedrooms; private inventory runs to $13M for a 5,346 SF five-bedroom. Resort residences suit seasonal and investment-oriented ownership with an optional rental pool; private residences carry a six-month minimum rental term. Maintenance is $2.20 per square foot. Deposit schedule: 10% at contract, 10% at 90 days, 10% at groundbreaking (Q3 2027), 10% at top-off (Q4 2028), and 60% at closing (Q4 2030). Broker compensation: 6% total (2% at 20% deposit, 3% at 30% deposit, 1% at closing).
name: Anantara Miami Resort & Residences
rentalPolicy: Optional hotel rental program on resort residences · 6-month minimum on private residences
residenceContent: The tower splits into two distinct residential products above the hotel podium. Resort Residences on floors 11 through 22 comprise 100 fully furnished homes by Patricia Urquiola with 10-foot ceilings, a dedicated arrival lobby, and optional participation in Anantara's hotel rental management program. Private Residences on floors 23 through 47 comprise 100 unfurnished homes with 11-foot ceilings, private elevators, a separate lobby and elevator bank, and exclusive access to the seventh-floor private amenity deck in addition to the full hotel program. Both collections share in-residence dining, room service, house car service, and the project's 130,000-square-foot indoor and outdoor amenity stack, including a 30,000-square-foot Vitality and Longevity Center on the sixth floor, six food and beverage concepts with a Michelin-starred anchor, and a full-service beach club with dedicated transportation. A rooftop helipad offers preferred access to BLADE charter services.
statusRemark: Public launch later in 2026 · Closing targeted Q4 2030 · Early-access inquiries open.
